system_description.narrative_title: US–Iran escalation under Trump: strikes, deterrence, and ally pressure
system_description.narrative_summary: News converge on a single dominant narrative: a cyclical U.S.–Iran military confrontation driven by Trump administration strike decisions, Iranian retaliations, and intense pressure from regional allies. The window shows rapid escalation (strikes, plans to escalate further), episodic de-escalation when Gulf partners press for restraint, and tangible spillovers to diplomacy, embassies, and energy markets. The system is driven by feedback loops among military actions, political signaling, allied influence, and economic impacts.
system_description.scope: U.S. executive decisions and military operations targeting Iran, Iranian military and political responses (missiles, drones, surprise attacks), Middle East regional states (Gulf allies, Kuwait), immediate diplomatic/consular advisories, and short-term energy market reactions.
system_description.super_system: International security and geopolitical order (Middle East conflict-economy nexus) affecting global stability and markets
adjacent_subsystems: Regional Gulf-state diplomacy and security arrangements
Global energy markets (oil & gas prices, energy infrastructure risk)
U.S. domestic political and policymaking processes

variables.name: Strike authorization propensity
variables.description: The degree to which executive decision-makers are inclined to authorize offensive military strikes.

variables.name: Offensive strike rate
variables.description: The frequency of initiated kinetic or armed strike operations per unit time in the theater.

variables.name: Retaliatory strike rate
variables.description: The rate at which counter- or retaliatory armed responses occur after an initial attack.

variables.name: Ally restraint pressure
variables.description: The level of political and diplomatic pressure from regional partners urging restraint or de-escalation.

variables.name: Diplomatic tension level
variables.description: The overall intensity of diplomatic hostility and strain between the conflicting sides and their partners.

variables.name: Embassy and consular risk level
variables.description: The assessed threat to diplomatic posts and consular operations in the region.

variables.name: Energy market volatility
variables.description: The short‑term variability in energy prices and market indicators linked to regional security developments.

variables.name: Risk to energy infrastructure
variables.description: The probability and intent of attacks or disruptions targeting energy production, transport, or storage assets.

variables.name: Military presence level
variables.description: The aggregate scale of deployed military forces and platforms operating in the theater.

variables.name: Munitions and matériel stockpile
variables.description: The on‑hand quantity of weapons, munitions, and strike-capable matériel available to forces in the region.

variables.name: Intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance coverage
variables.description: The extent and persistence of ISR assets providing situational awareness across the operational area.

variables.name: Travel advisory intensity
variables.description: The severity and prevalence of official travel warnings and evacuation advisories issued for the region.

variables.name: Economic coercion level
variables.description: The strength and scope of economic pressure measures such as sanctions, tariffs, or trade restrictions.

variables.name: Cyber-attack activity rate
variables.description: The frequency of offensive cyber operations and disruptive intrusions related to the confrontation.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: The degree of active negotiation, back‑channel diplomacy, and mediated contacts aimed at managing the dispute.

variables.name: Domestic political support for force
variables.description: The level of public and elite domestic backing for the use of military force or escalation.

catalysts.title: Potential U.S. renewed strike campaign
catalysts.description: U.S. authorities may reverse recent cancellations and resume a planned escalation of strikes against Iran in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: "Trump approves new Iran strikes that could begin this weekend"; "The U.S. Commander With a Two-Week Plan to Escalate Strikes in Iran"

catalysts.title: Gulf states pressure for restraint
catalysts.description: Gulf partners will continue pressing Washington to delay or limit strikes and pursue talks, shaping U.S. choices and allied coordination.
catalysts.rationale: "Gulf States Pressed Trump to Hold Off on Iran Strikes and Pursue Talks"; "Gulf States Talked Trump Out of Iran Strikes"

catalysts.title: Expanded embassy evacuations and travel advisories
catalysts.description: U.S. and allied embassies will broaden travel warnings and evacuation guidance across the Middle East amid signs of possible military action.
catalysts.rationale: "U.S. embassies issue evacuation warnings across Middle East amid Iran strikes"; "Embassies warn Americans of travel risk"

catalysts.title: Iran threatens regional energy fields
catalysts.description: Iran's explicit threats to strike energy infrastructure if the U.S. launches fresh attacks raise the risk to energy assets and markets.
catalysts.rationale: "Iran threatens regional energy fields if the U.S. launches fresh attacks"; "Iran threatens to strike other nations' energy fields"

catalysts.title: Planned US–Israel bombardment of energy targets
catalysts.description: Reported planning by the U.S. and Israel to bombard energy-related targets in Iran could produce targeted strikes on Iran's energy infrastructure.
catalysts.rationale: "US, Israel planning to bombard energy-related targets in Iran, CBS reports"

catalysts.title: Iranian regional drone and surprise attacks
catalysts.description: Iran's use of drones and surprise attacks in the region will likely continue, prompting interceptions and possible counterstrikes.
catalysts.rationale: "Kuwait intercepts Iranian drones as Trump weighs fresh strikes"; "Iran Gambles on Escalation With Surprise Attack on U.S. Forces"

catalysts.title: Patriot missile sale and regional air‑defense deployments
catalysts.description: The large Patriot missile deal and stockpile concerns will drive deployments and stockpile adjustments in the theater over coming months.
catalysts.rationale: "US strikes $58.6 billion Patriot missile deal amid rising stockpile concerns"

catalysts.title: Push for sanctions bill including tariffs
catalysts.description: A legislative push to include tariffs in an Iran sanctions package could raise economic coercion and shape domestic political support for tough measures.
catalysts.rationale: "Trump says sanctions bill should include tariffs on Iran, despite 'trivial' trade with U.S."

catalysts.title: Revival of ally compensation plan
catalysts.description: Reviving a plan to compensate regional allies could shift allied calculus, reduce restraint pressure, and increase diplomatic coordination with the U.S.
catalysts.rationale: "Trump Says He’ll Revive Plan to Compensate Allies After Declaring It ‘Dead’"
